sections.title: Overview
descriptions: In the Ben Schneider (Reckless Ben) case, Kyle Bradley Pitt interviewed the March 10 complainant, contacted Sandy police, and transported Ben to AFPD after his arrest.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Officer Pitt began working for the American Fork Police Department on July 14, 2025.

contents.text_value: March 10, 2026: Pitt spoke with the complainant, Joshua Johnson, and contacted a Sandy police officer about related incidents. After Sumbot arrested Ben, Pitt transported him to AFPD to wait for transport to jail. See pages 11–13. Pitt wrote the March 10 supplement on page 13 describing his contacts and transport.

contents.label: Bodycam captures American Fork officer rescuing woman from highway overpass
contents.description: Based on the body-camera footage, the rescue occurred on August 22, 2026. KUTV reported that Officer Kyle Bradley Pitt helped a woman experiencing a mental health crisis on a highway overpass, grabbing her as she slipped through the fence and pulling her back to safety. This is an example of compassionate, effective handling of a mental health crisis—the kind of officer compassion and response this project seeks to promote.
